description: Static check for WCAG 1.3.2 Meaningful Sequence and 2.4.3 Focus Order. Pass `source` as HTML with style blocks and inline styles, or as bare CSS. Flags CSS order, row-reverse and column-reverse, grid-auto-flow: dense, explicit grid placement, absolute and fixed positioning, right floats, positive tabindex, a footer before main in the DOM and skipped heading levels. Returns the DOM sequence of landmarks and headings so you can compare it with the visual order. Reads the pasted source only; nothing is rendered or run, stored or logged. It does not compute layout, so media-query rules are flattened and selectors are not matched to elements.

source.description: HTML with style blocks, or CSS.

name: check_reading_order
title: Reading order check
